name: ZFP Block-Based Compression
definition: A floating-point compression algorithm using fixed-rate compression, encoding blocks of 4x4x4 floating-point values. It is a de facto standard in the HPC community.
summary: ZFP Block-Based Compression is a floating-point algorithm that compresses 4x4x4 volumes using deterministic tensor-product transforms and bit-plane encoding, ensuring predictable, artifact-free performance with random access.
